# ScribeAmerica

> > ScribeAmerica provides medical scribe services and allied health solutions to reduce physician burnout, improve clinical documentation, and enhance patient care across emergency departments and ambulatory practices.

ScribeAmerica is the leading medical scribe company in the United States, offering EHR documentation support, emergency department scribes, and medical assistant staffing through its Enabli Health division. The company focuses on addressing provider burnout, improving healthcare efficiency, and supporting value-based care initiatives while maintaining HIPAA compliance and quality standards.

## Key Topics

- Medical scribes
- Physician burnout reduction
- Emergency department efficiency
- EHR documentation
- Clinical documentation improvement
- HIPAA compliance
- Value-based care
- Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs)
- Patient experience (HCAHPS)
- Healthcare workforce solutions
- Data analytics
- CMS quality measures

- Medical assistant staffing
- Healthcare quality improvement

## Core Services & Solutions

- [Emergency Room (ER) Scribes | Emergency Medical Scribes](https://www.scribeamerica.com/emergency-department): ER scribe services for emergency departments to improve efficiency
- [Scribes reduce physician burnout by 27%](https://www.scribeamerica.com/scribes-reduce-physician-burnout): Medical scribes reduce physician burnout and improve patient satisfaction
- [Medical Assistants - Allied Health Solutions - Enabli Health](https://www.scribeamerica.com/medical-assistants): Medical assistant staffing solutions for ambulatory practices by Enabli
- [Diversity, Equity & Inclusion](https://www.scribeamerica.com/diversity-inclusion): DEI Council and workplace diversity programs at ScribeAmerica
